description: Only tracks whose file size is strictly above the threshold are included.

a.request: For tracks with a file size (`Bytes`) greater than 10323804, what is the average `UnitPrice` and the average bytes per millisecond (`Bytes` divided by `Milliseconds`, as a decimal ratio)? Ignore missing values and don't round.
a.sql: SELECT AVG(UnitPrice) AS avg_unit_price, AVG(CAST(Bytes AS REAL) / Milliseconds) AS avg_bytes_per_ms FROM Track WHERE Bytes > 10323804 AND Bytes IS NOT NULL AND Milliseconds IS NOT NULL AND Milliseconds <> 0

c.request: Taking 10323804 bytes as the cutoff for a large track, what is the average `UnitPrice` of the large tracks and their average bytes per millisecond (`Bytes` divided by `Milliseconds`, as a decimal ratio)? Ignore missing values and don't round. Only tracks whose file size is strictly above the threshold are included.
c.sql: SELECT AVG(UnitPrice) AS avg_unit_price, AVG(CAST(Bytes AS REAL) / Milliseconds) AS avg_bytes_per_ms FROM Track WHERE Bytes > 10323804 AND Bytes IS NOT NULL AND Milliseconds IS NOT NULL AND Milliseconds <> 0

b.request: Considering only tracks whose `Bytes` is strictly greater than 10323804 (excluding tracks with missing values), what are the average `UnitPrice` and the average of `Bytes` divided by `Milliseconds` as an unrounded decimal ratio?
b.sql: SELECT AVG(UnitPrice) AS avg_unit_price, AVG(CAST(Bytes AS REAL) / Milliseconds) AS avg_bytes_per_ms FROM Track WHERE Bytes IS NOT NULL AND Bytes > 10323804
b.raw: Considering only tracks whose `Bytes` is strictly greater than 10323804 (excluding tracks with missing values), what are the average `UnitPrice` and the average of `Bytes` divided by `Milliseconds` as an unrounded decimal ratio?

d.request: Using only tracks whose `Bytes` is strictly greater than 10323804 (not equal to it), what are the average `UnitPrice` and the average of `Bytes` divided by `Milliseconds` as an unrounded decimal ratio, ignoring tracks with missing values?
d.sql: SELECT AVG(UnitPrice) AS avg_unit_price, AVG(CAST(Bytes AS REAL) / Milliseconds) AS avg_bytes_per_ms FROM Track WHERE Bytes > 10323804 AND UnitPrice IS NOT NULL AND Milliseconds IS NOT NULL AND Milliseconds <> 0
